research_line.name: Urban spatial generalization and scientific reproducibility
research_line.problem: Spatial machine learning for urban phenomena may appear accurate under random data splits but fail to generalize to new neighborhoods, cities, or periods. What falsifiable, literature-grounded research questions can quantify and explain these failures?
research_line.goals: Discover independently testable urban-planning and computer-science research opportunities. Require held-out-area or held-out-time evaluation, credible baselines, and explicit uncertainty. This is a GENERIC PUBLIC methodological profile, not the user's team database profile.
